_comment: Pluggable target-model guidance registry. The skill never hardcodes guidance text: `prompt_audit.py fetch-guidance` downloads every source below at run time into the cache, stamps it with the fetch date and sha256, and extracts current model IDs from the `models` sources. `verified_on` is the last date a human confirmed the URL is the official, current source; the fetcher warns when it is older than `stale_after_days`. Add a lab by adding an entry; add a source by appending to `sources`.

sources.note: Base method (Apache-2.0). Re-fetched 2026-10-17: adds reasoning/thinking/trace JSON fields to the reasoning-extraction row and Haiku 5.5 to the harness rows. Claude Code 2.1.302 still hands /doctor prompt-audit to this text.
Per-target removal checklists. Read the section for the resolved target only.
Official Sep 11 2026 guidance: short skill descriptions, progressive disclosure, no mandatory pre-reads, no generic test reminders, soften over-strong ask-first boundaries, define completion.

GPT-6 family guide: Astra asks more and is more sensitive to AGENTS.md/skill text; audit skills for instructions that pause work; temperature/top_p rejected unless effort is none; Astra and 6.1 Sol reject effort none/minimal.

Discovery order: AGENTS.override.md replaces AGENTS.md per directory (first non-empty wins); 32 KiB project_doc_max_bytes cap. Moved from developers.openai.com/codex/guides/agents-md (308) by 2026-10-17.

Skill locations (.agents/skills up to repo root, ~/.agents/skills), initial list capped at 2% of context or 8,000 chars; descriptions shortened first. Moved from developers.openai.com/codex/skills (308) by 2026-10-17.

google.note: The Google Cloud 'Gemini 3 prompting guide' page (search-indexed under docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/...) returned 404 on 2026-09-29, so it is not registered. Its 'do not infer/guess over-indexes' advice is cited from the ai.google.dev page only where that page says the same.

sources.note: Gemini 3 section: direct prompts, no persuasive language, constraints at the end for long context; 'Think very hard' still documented as a lever. Gemini 4 and 3.6+ ignore custom temperature/top_p/top_k (deprecation warning, 400 later).
What's new in Gemini 4 Argon: thinking_level low/medium/high (medium default), raise max_output_tokens to >= 32K for apps set lower.

open-weights.note: No first-party prompting guide registered. Files read only by these models are audited with the lab-neutral rows (Groups 2-4 and drift) and Group 1 at low confidence.
